Summary

 (1) The dependence of u on x and t is separated u ( x , t ) = X ( x )T (t ) , and then
   one  partial  differential  equation becomes two ordinary  differential
    equations, by introducing the eigenvalue λ.
 (2) The eigenvalue λn and the eigenfunction Xn(x) can be obtained by solving
    the equation of X(x) by using the homogeneous boundary conditions.

(3) Substitute λn to the equation of T(t), and find the solution Tn(t).

 (4) The general solution                      u n ( x , t ) = X n ( x )Tn (t )   is the linear superposition         ∑

    of the particular solutions, and the coefficients are obtained by using the
     initial conditions.
